chunks.text: Established family-run garage in Llanishen

At Llanishen M.O.T & Service Centre Ltd, we offer a comprehensive range of garage services at competitive prices. We have a collection and delivery service along with a courtesy car. Visit our garage today to take advantage of our services.

Established in 1924, we are an independent family-run business based in Llanishen providing top-class car repairs and servicing for all makes and models at affordable prices. From MOTs to vehicle repairs and servicing, you can rely on our team of expert mechanics for a prompt and reliable service. Get in touch with us today to discuss your requirements or for a free quote.

Here at Llanishen M.O.T & Service Centre Ltd, we provide dealership type facilities, including a pickup and delivery service. Courtesy cars are also available on request. Speak to a member of our team today for more details.

In the UK, MOTs are essential to determine the reliability and the road safety of vehicles. At Llanishen M.O.T & Service Centre Ltd, we carry out thorough checks to make sure your vehicle meets the necessary safety regulations before being sent for an MOT test. Bring your vehicle down to our garage today for an MOT test or for a free estimate.

We carry out all the necessary checks by using state-of-the-art equipment. Vehicles can be accepted for MOT tests up to one month before the expiration date of the previous MOT. No appointment is needed for MOT tests, MOTs can be carried out while you wait. Contact us today to book an appointment.
